{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the trial data
data = pd.read_csv('/home/musel/Github/research_agent/data/trial.csv')

# Replace sentinel value -999.0 with NaN in biomarker_baseline
data['biomarker_baseline'] = data['biomarker_baseline'].replace(-999.0, pd.NA)

# Compute response rates by severity (to check for confounding)
response_by_severity = data.groupby(['arm', 'severity'])['responded'].mean().unstack(fill_value=0)

# Compute response rates by site
response_by_site = data.groupby(['arm', 'site'])['responded'].mean().unstack(fill_value=0)

# Compute response rates by sex
response_by_sex = data.groupby(['arm', 'sex'])['responded'].mean().unstack(fill_value=0)

# Print results
print("Response rates by severity:")
print(response_by_severity)

print("\nResponse rates by site:")
print(response_by_site)

print("\nResponse rates by sex:")
print(response_by_sex)"}
